s: puM, (nAsti vIciH prakASaH suKaM vA atra .) narakaviSezaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (“avIcimanDatAmisraM kumBIpAkaM taTEva ca । asipatravanaYcEva tApanaYcEva viMSakam” ॥ iti yAjYavalkye ॥) vAcyaliNgastu taraNgaSUnye ॥

puM, (nAsti vIciH suKaM yasmin) narakaviSezaH । yaTA । “vEtaraRI pUyodaH prARaroDo viSasanaM lAlABakzaH sArameyAdanamavIcirayaHpAnamiti । ya stviha vA anftaM vadati sAkzye dravyavinimaye dAne vA kaTaYcit sa vE pretya narake avIcimatyaDaHSirA niravakASe yojanaSatocCrAyAt girimUrdDnaH saMpAtyate । yatra jalamiva sTalamaSmapfzWamaBAsate tadavIcimat tilaSo viSIryyamARaSarIro na mriyamARaH punarAropito nipatati” । iti SrIBAgavate 5 skanDe 26 aDyAyaH ॥
v: pu॰ nAsti vIciH prakASaH suKaM vAtra । 1 narakaBede tatsvarUpaM tatkAraRaYca BAgavate 5 ska॰ darSitaM yaTA “tAmisronDatAmisra” ityAdyupakramya “avIcirayaHpAnamityAdinA azwAviMSatinarakAn viBajya “yastvihAnftaM vadati sAkzye, dravyavinimaye, dAne vA kaTaYcit, sa vEpretya narake avIcimatyaDaHSirA niravakASe yojanaSatocCrAyAt girimUrdDaH sampAtyate । yatra jalamiva sTalamaSmapfzWamavaBAsate tadavIcirnAma tilaSoviSIryyamARaSarIro na mriyamARaH punarAropito nipatati”--avIcimAn avIcimayo'pyatra । 2 taraNgaSUnye jalASaye tri॰ ।

अ-वीचि m. a particular hell, Yājñ. iii, 224; Buddh. &c.
a: अवीचि — a. Waveless. --चिः N. of a particular hell; ˚मयः a place of punishment for liars (यत्र जलमिव स्थलमश्मपृष्ठमवभासते Bhāg.)

v: tri॰ nAsti vIjamasya । vIjaSUnye 1 PalAdO । 2 drAkzAyAM strI । vIjAnADAyake tri॰ “avIjamapi kzetraM kevalaM sTaRqilaM Bavet” manuH । aprASastye na॰ ta॰ । aNkurotpAdanAyAsamarTe trEhAyARAdO 3 vIje ca । “avIjavikrayI cEva vIjotkfzwaM taTEva ca” manuH । “avIjaM prarohAsamarTamiti” kullU॰ । vIjaM SukraM na॰ ba॰ । Sukrarahite 4 klIve na॰ । “na mUtraM PenilaM yasya vizWA cApsu nimajjati । meQraMconmAdaSukrAByAM sa klIva iti kaTyate” smftestasya taTAtvam । “unmattaM patitaM klIvamavIja’ pAparogiRam” iti manuH । 5 kAraRaSUnye tri॰ 6 yogokte nirvIje cittavfttipariRAmaniroDe pu॰ ।
m: अ-वीज &c. See अ-बीज.
a: अवीज --जक(अबीज) — 1 Seedless; Ms. 10. 71. --2 Impotent; Ms. 9. 79. --3 Having no prime cause. --जः Restraint, controlling the mental passions. --जा Vine plant. --जं 1 Bad seed, bad grain; ˚विक्रयिन् Ms. 9. 291. --2 Absence of seed. --Comp. --हन् a. Ved. not pernicious to men.

s: strI, (nAsti vIraH puttrAdiryasyAH .) ajAtApatyaviDavA । iti smftiH । nizpatisutA । ityamaramedinyO ॥ tadannaBojane dozaprAyaScitte yaTA, -- “yo vipro'vIrAnnaBojI ftusnAtAnnaBojakaH । BagajIvI vArdDuziko vizahIno yaToragaH” ॥ iti brakzmavEvartte prakftiKaRqe 21 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ api ca । “avIrAnnaYca yo BuNkte yonijIvI ca brAhmaRaH । yastrisanDyAvihInaSca sa gohatyAM laBet DruvaM” ॥ iti ca tatrEva 27 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ vizRuH । gaRagaRikAstenagAyanakAnnAni BuktvA saptarAtraM payasA vartteta । avIrAstrIsvarRakArasaMsargapatitAnAYca । iti prAyaScittavivekaH ॥ * ॥ sAmAnyenABojyAnnaBojanaprakaraRe manuH, -- “nASrotriyahute yajYe grAmayAjihute taTA” । ityAdi । “anarcitaM vfTAmAMsamavIrAyASca yozitaH” ityAdikaYcopakramya । “BuktvA cAnyatamasyAnnamamatyAkzapaRaM tryahaM” । “matyA BuktvA caret kfcCraM reto viRmUtrameva” ॥ iti । avIrA patiputtravihInA niHsambanDinI । svasambanDinyAstu SrAdDAdinAByanujYAnAt vyavahArAt DanADikArAcca । iti ca prAyaScittavivekaH ॥ * ॥ asyA DanADikAro yaTA yAjYavalkyaH, -- “patnI duhitaraScEva pitarO BrAtarastaTA । tatsuto gotrajo banDuH SizyAH sabrahmacAriRaH ॥ ezAmaBAve pUrvvasya DanaBAguttarottaraH । svaryyAtasya hyaputtrasya sarvvavarRezvayaM viDiH” ॥ taTA vizRuH । aputtrasya DanaM patnyaBigAmi tadaBAve duhitfgAmi । ityAdi । tena prapOttraparyyantAnAmaBAve patnI DanADikAriRI । yaTA kAtyAyanaH । “BarttfdAyaM mfte patyO vinyaset strI yaTezwataH । vidyamAne tu saMrakzet kzapayet tatkule'nyaTA ॥ aputtrA SayanaM BarttuH pAlayantI vrate sTitA । BuYjItAmaraRAt kzAntA dAyAdA UrdDvamApnuyuH” ॥ yaTezwata iti DarmmATaM । taTA ca vyAsaH । “lokAntarasTaM BarttAramAtmAnaYca varAnane । tArayatyuBayaM nArI nityaM DarmmaparAyaRA” ॥ madanapArijAtaDftA smftiH । “yadyadizwatamaM loke yadyat patyuH samIhitaM । tattadguRavate deyaM patiprIRanakAmyayA” ॥ BarttuH SayanaM pAlayantI nAnyagAminI । ataeva harivaMSIyapuRyakavratopAKyAne ॥ “dAnopavAsapuRyAni sukftAnyapyarunDuti । nizPalAnyasatInAM hi puRyakAni taTA SuBe” ॥ taTA vfhanmanuH, -- “aputrA SayanaM BarttuH pAlayantI vrate sTitA । patnyeva dadyAt tatpiRqaM kftsnamaMSaM laBeta ca” ॥ tatpiRqamityatra tadityanuzajya । tacCabdena BarttuH parAmarSAt BarttuH kftsnamaMSaM yAvadaMSaM haret na tu varttanocitamAtraM । iti dAyatattvaM ॥ * ॥ asyAH patiSrAdDADikAro yaTA । putrapOtraprapOtrABAve patnI । taTA ca SaNKaH । “pituH putreRa karttavyA piRqadAnodakakriyA । tadaBAve tu patnI syAt tadaBAve sahodaraH ॥ BAryyApiRqaM patirddadyAt Bartre BAryyA taTEva ca । SvaSvrAdeSca snuzA cEva tadaBAve dvijottamaH” ॥ ityAdi ॥ “aputrA strI yaTA putraH putravatyapi Barttari । piRqaM dadyAt jalaYcEva jalamAtrantu putriRI” ॥ iti nirmUlaM samUlatve'pi bAladeSAntaritaputrasadBAvavizayamiti SrAdDavivekapraBftayaH । iti ॥ * ॥ asyA BartrAditarpaRADikAro yaTA smftiH । “tarpaRaM pratyahaM kAryyaM BarttuH kuSatilodakEH । tatpitustatpituScApi nAmagotrAdipUrvvakaM” ॥ etattu tarpaRaM putrapOtrAdyaBAvavizayamiti madanapArijAtaH । iti ॥ * ॥ mftAyAstasyA AdyaSrAdDAdi paYcadaSaSrAdDaM karttavyaM na tu sapiRqanaM । yaTA । atra sapatnIputrasya putratvAtideSAt tatsatve'pi strIRAM sapiRqanaM mETilEruktaM tanna । “putreREva tu karttavyaM sapiRqIkaraRaM striyAH । puruzasya punastvanye BrAtfputrAdayo'pi ye” ॥ iti laGuhArItavacane evakAreRa atidizwaputranizeDAt । putreReti tatsattvamAtravivakzitaM । “sapiRqIkaraRaM tAsAM putrABAve na vidyate” । iti mArkaRqeyapurAREkavAkyatvAt । “yAni paYcadaSAdyAni aputrasyetarARi ca । ekasyEva tu dAtavyamaputrAyASca yozitaH” ॥ iti CandogapariSizwena AdyapaYcadaSaSrAdDEH pretatvaparIhAroktatvAcca । etatpatyuraBAve drazwavyaM । tataSca SiSO putre anyenApi sapiRqyate । evaM patisatve'pi । ataeva mETilEravIrAyAH sapiRqanaM nAstItyuktaM । iti ca SudDitattvaM ॥
m: अ-वीरा f. (a woman) who has no husband, a widow, RV. x, 86, 9; BhP.
one who has neither husband nor son, Mn. iv, 213; Yājñ. i, 163

m: अ-वीर mfn. unmanly, weak, RV. vii, 61, 4 and x, 95, 3
having no sons, RV. vii, 4, 6
without heroes, Bālar.
अ-वीर (अम्), n. a country destitute of heroes or men, ŚBr.
a: अवीर — a. 1 Unmanly, effeminate, cowardly. --2 Having no son (as a woman). --3 Helpless. --4 Destitute of men. --रा A woman who has neither sons nor husband; अजातपुत्रा विधवा साऽवीरा परिकीर्तिता; (opp. वीरा which is thus defined; पतिपुत्रवती नारी वीरा प्रोक्ता मनीषिभिः); अनर्चितं वृथा मांसमवीरांयाश्च योषितः Ms. 4. 213; Y. 1. 163.

m: अ-वीर-घ्न mfn. not killing men, Hir.
अ-वीर-घ्न—स्थ mfn. not standing out heroes, cowardly, Kath.
अ-वीर—हन् mf(-घ्नी)n. not killing men, not pernicious to men, RV. i, 91, 19; VS.; AV.
अ-वीर—जुष्ट mfn. not liked by men, Mṛcch.

अ-वीर्य mf(आ)n. weak, ineffective, ŚBr.
अ-वीर्य—वत् (अ-वीर्य-), mfn. weak, powerless, MaitrS.
